headline: Valkyries 83, Aces 81: Burton clutch three puts Golden State up 2-0
whyCareReason: The first-year Valkyries edged the powerhouse Aces 83-81 behind Veronica Burton's late three and Kiah Stokes' final block.
teaser: Hayes scored 21 off the bench and Williams added 20 as Golden State held off A'ja Wilson. Game 3 shifts to Las Vegas.
story: The Golden State Valkyries took a 2-0 series lead over the Las Vegas Aces on Wednesday night with a thrilling 83-81 win at Chase Center. After Las Vegas took its first lead of the contest with under two minutes remaining, Veronica Burton connected on a deep go-ahead 3-pointer with 41 seconds on the clock. In the closing seconds, Kiah Stokes blocked Chelsea Gray's driving layup, and Burton secured the defensive rebound to ice the contest. Tiffany Hayes led Golden State with 21 points off the bench, while Gabby Williams added 20 points and 5 rebounds. A'ja Wilson led Las Vegas with 24 points and 7 rebounds, while Chelsea Gray added 19 points and 6 assists. The series moves to Michelob ULTRA Arena in Las Vegas for Game 3 on Friday 9 October with the Aces facing elimination.
stakes: The expansion Valkyries need one more win to reach the WNBA Finals in their inaugural season. The Aces face a win-or-go-home Game 3.
rivalryAngle: The expansion Valkyries have stunned the two-time champion Aces in consecutive games to begin the series.
